planets.name: HD 260655 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 260655 with a 2.77-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 260655 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 260655. Its orbit and size follow Luque et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LUQUE_ET_AL_2022): disc_year 2022, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 2.7694936, pl_radj 0.11062558, pl_bmassj 0.00673319

quotes.title: HD 260655
quotes.card: HD 260655 has two confirmed rocky planets, named HD 260655 b and HD 260655 c, that were discovered in 2022.
quotes.introduction: Both planets were detected by the TESS mission and confirmed independently with archival and new precise radial velocity data obtained with the HIRES observatory since 1998, and the CARMENES survey instruments since 2016.
